expectations: No search or retrieval tools beyond the health tool
context: constitution: v1.0.0 (Oracle AI Database 26ai reference DB, credentials from env, tests first)
area: greenfield repo, no source yet
intent: Reproducible local dev environment for golestan_code_mcp: Oracle 26ai container, Python project with parser and MCP SDK, sample repos, stub MCP server

decisions.decision: Official container-registry.oracle.com/database/free image via Compose with named volume
decisions.why: Constitution names 26ai; image has setup-script hook and healthcheck script
decisions.rejected: gvenzl/oracle-free (community, tags may trail 26ai), adb-free (needs SYS_ADMIN/FUSE)

decisions.decision: First-run script creates app user with DB_DEVELOPER_ROLE from env
decisions.why: Least privilege, no password in committed SQL

decisions.decision: oracledb thin mode with 3 s connect timeout
decisions.why: No Instant Client on Windows, VECTOR support, fast health when DB down
One-command install with exact pins; avoids Python 3.14 first on PATH

decisions.decision: mcp[cli] 1.x FastMCP over stdio, tool named health
decisions.why: Stable widely deployed API, works with mcp dev Inspector

decisions.decision: tree-sitter + per-language grammar wheels; no parser module yet
decisions.why: Prebuilt Windows wheels; extraction module waits for ingestion

decisions.decision: All scripts as Python console entry points run via uv run
decisions.why: Same command in PowerShell and POSIX

plan.summary: Plan: Compose Oracle 26ai Free + uv Python 3.11 package with check-db, clone-samples and stdio MCP server exposing health
plan.key_finding: Docker daemon (Rancher Desktop) is not running yet; python3 shim on PATH mangles quoted args, use py -3 or uv run

tasks.summary: 25 tasks: Setup, Foundational (config), US1 DB, US2 parser, US3 samples, US4 MCP health (after US1), Polish

approach: Compose runs Oracle AI Database 26ai Free with a named volume and a first-run app-user script. A uv-managed Python 3.11 package pins oracledb, tree-sitter grammars and mcp, and exposes three console commands: golestan-check-db, golestan-clone-samples and the golestan-code-mcp stdio server with a health tool.
